prompt_lineage.validation: must equal the caller's already-authenticated prompt record

terminal_evidence_lineage.validation: must equal the caller-supplied accepted terminal evidence record

selection.ordering: descending rounded finite FP16 numeric logit; equal logits use ascending token ID
selection.numeric_binding: each logit_q24 must be the exact decode of logit_f16_bits

authority.lineage: must equal the caller-supplied receipt-use authority lineage
authority.bridge_behavior: read-only validation; authority is neither created nor consumed

receipt_chain.ordering: generation ordinals must increase by exactly one with no duplicates or gaps
receipt_chain.prompt_record: every receipt must carry the same authenticated prompt_lineage record
receipt_chain.input_token_history: each receipt must equal the authenticated prompt token IDs followed by all prior selected token IDs
receipt_chain.terminal_evidence_chain: the caller supplies one initial parent plus one accepted terminal-evidence record per receipt; each receipt must bind its indexed parent_terminal_evidence and terminal_evidence exactly
receipt_chain.authority_chain: the caller supplies one expected receipt-use authority lineage per receipt; every authority must be explicitly authorized and unconsumed
receipt_chain.operation: validate each receipt read-only, append each selected token in order, and decode the complete resulting token history with the supplied authenticated tokenizer

output.operation: append the validated selected token ID to the authenticated prompt token history and decode that token with the supplied authenticated tokenizer

claim_boundary.demonstrated: validation-only single selected-token and ordered multi-receipt dialogue bridges
excluded: Model24 model, oracle, or RTL invocation
